mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing citalopram plasma concentrations; combined CNS depression and potential QT prolongation risk with citalopram at higher doses.
action: Monitor for reduced antidepressant efficacy; consider citalopram dose adjustment upward if needed; monitor QTc interval, especially at citalopram doses >40mg daily; assess for increased seizure breakthrough or CNS effects.
